title: A study to learn about the effects of Trontinemab in participants at risk for Alzheimer‘s disease
official: A Phase III, Multicenter, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Parallel-Group Efficacy and Safety Study of Trontinemab in Cognitively Unimpaired Individuals at Risk for Progression to Symptomatic Alzheimer’s Disease
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the efficacy of trontinemab on clinical progression compared with placebo
conditions: Cognitively Unimpaired Individuals at Risk for Progression to Symptomatic Alzheimer’s Disease (AD)
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Individuals aged ≥ 55 to ≤ 64 must have at least one of the following additional risk factors prior to screening: – First degree relative diagnosed with dementia onset before age 75
2. Body weight of 150 kg or less
3. Adequate visual and auditory acuity, in the investigator’s judgment, sufficient to perform the neuropsychological testing (eyewear and hearing aids are permitted)
4. Cognitively and functionally unimpaired
5. Agreement to adhere to the contraception requirements (highly effective methods for female participants <1% error rate)
6. Agreement not to donate blood or blood products for transfusion for the duration of the study and for 1 year after final dose of study drug
Exclusion criteria:
1. Any evidence of a condition other than AD that may affect cognition, including, but not limited to, frontotemporal dementia, dementia with Lewy bodies, vascular dementia, Parkinson disease, corticobasal syndrome, Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease, progressive supranuclear palsy, frontotemporal lobar degeneration (other than frontotemporal dementia), Huntington disease, normal pressure hydrocephalus, seizure disorder, delirium, or hypoxia
2. MCI (may be referred to as prodromal AD), or any form of dementia
3. History of severe, clinically significant (persistent neurologic deficit or structural brain damage) central nervous system (CNS) trauma
4. History of schizophrenia, schizoaffective disorder, major depression, or bipolar disorder
5. Uncontrolled hypertension (e.g., blood pressure generally >160 mmHg systolic or > 95 mmHg diastolic)
6. Pregnancy or breastfeeding, or intending to become pregnant during the study
